plugins.name: claude-evolve
plugins.description: Evolutionary algorithm search inside Claude Code or Codex. Ideate new algorithm variants (Opus, Codex Astra, Grok), write their code (Codex first, Opus judge/fallback), and score them against your evaluator — driven generation-by-generation off a single evolution.csv. The omnibus /evolve skill runs the whole loop as a self-respawning pool of background worker subagents.
